title: Medical Records Request (Release of Information) Desk Reference: Request Channels, Record Scope and Delivery Formats
content:
Quick reference for the Riverbend Regional Health Patient Access Center and the HIM office on how a Medical Records Request (Release of Information) may come in, what record scope applies when the requester sets none, and the delivery and file formats each request type offers.

## Delivery formats offered, by request type

| Request type | Delivery formats offered |
|---|---|
| Patient Access - Electronic Copy | patient portal download; encrypted email; CD or DVD |
| Patient Access - Paper Copy | paper copy by mail; paper copy held for pickup |
| Patient-Directed Transmission to a Third Party | encrypted email; paper copy by mail; CD or DVD |
| Authorized Release - Attorney or Legal Representative | encrypted email; paper copy by mail; CD or DVD |
| Authorized Release - Insurer or Disability Carrier | encrypted email; paper copy by mail |
| Amendment of Health Record Request | paper copy by mail; patient portal download |
| Accounting of Disclosures Request | paper copy by mail; patient portal download |

## Settings that are the same for every request type

The entries below hold identically for all seven request types — Patient Access - Electronic Copy, Patient Access - Paper Copy, Patient-Directed Transmission to a Third Party, Authorized Release - Attorney or Legal Representative, Authorized Release - Insurer or Disability Carrier, Amendment of Health Record Request and Accounting of Disclosures Request.

| Setting | Value for every request type |
|---|---|
| Channels through which a request is accepted | the patient portal; mail; fax; in person at the HIM office |
| Record scope used when the requester does not limit it (default record scope) | the full designated record set |
| Billing records part of the designated record set released | Yes |
| Electronic file formats offered | PDF; C-CDA XML |
| Format used for patient-directed transmissions | electronic when the records are held electronically |
| Days paper copies are held for pickup before being mailed (pickup holding period) | 30 calendar days |
| Days after an encounter's results finalize within which the results release to the portal automatically (portal release period) | 0 calendar days |

## Points of reference

- The channel list is closed at four entries: the patient portal, mail, fax and the HIM office in person.
- A request that names no limit on its scope covers the full designated record set, and billing records are part of that set.
- An electronic copy comes as a PDF or as C-CDA XML; no other electronic file format is listed.
- A paper copy set aside for pickup is held 30 calendar days and then mailed.
- The portal release figure of 0 days means an encounter's finalized results reach the portal with no waiting period.
- Paper pickup appears among the delivery formats of the Patient Access - Paper Copy request type only; CD or DVD appears for the Patient Access - Electronic Copy, Patient-Directed Transmission to a Third Party and Authorized Release - Attorney or Legal Representative request types.
